calls.summary:
# Feature x Design kick off
Date: 2026-08-19 | Duration: 33.75m

## Summary
The team acknowledged a significant design backlog due to no design input for nearly six months and also addressed the challenges following Kari's departure. Johnny and Gabe are supporting each other while identifying opportunities for improved collaboration between design and engineering. A siloed process has delayed feedback loops, exacerbated by resource shortages. The current workload is heavy, with 80% of work being unplanned, making it difficult to focus on key projects. Configs UX onboarding and managed features were recognized as top priorities, with significant emphasis placed on improving the onboarding process. There is also a proposal to revitalize regular syncs to enhance coordination, as no active Kanban system currently exists.

## Keywords
design collaboration, engineering workflow, backlog prioritization, product onboarding, feature flags, project management

## Action Items
**Johnny Martinez**  
Organize attendance in engineering standups (08:29)  
Prioritize design tasks from 5.1 release and backlog (11:59)  
Mark priorities in 5.1 features list (22:46)  

**Gabe Melean**  
Collaborate with Guy on AI-assisted setup flow (12:46)  
Learn about config feature (12:46)  
Participate in permissions design review (24:25)  
Be prepared to shift priority to managed features redesign (29:54)  

**Bryce Fitzsimons**  
Potentially revive Kanban board or implement project tracking tools (22:08)  
Demo config feature and onboarding complexity to designers (23:48)  
Coordinate on managed features redesign with Gabe and Johnny (30:52)
